evidence.name: Screen field: Text choices or numbers
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Text choices or numbers" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Text choices or numbers
sections.description: Chooses what the picker collects: String for text choices, which allows up to 5 side-by-side wheels (such as month / day / year), or Integer for a single numeric range (such as age or quantity). Set this first — it limits Integer to one wheel, unlocks up to five wheels for String, and changes how each wheel's options are set up below.
